description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page named EditTheory.aspx. It handles page events such as page load, button clicks for navigation, course selection, and semester selection, managing drop-down lists for course and semester selection, and session management.

classes.name: EditTheory
classes.description: A partial class representing the code-behind for the EditTheory ASP.NET page, managing event handling and UI logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, currently empty, used to initialize page state.

methods.description: Handles click event to transfer to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event to transfer to the Admin Queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles click event to transfer to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.description: Stores selected course information in session variable '_CRS'.

methods.description: Handles click event to transfer to the login page, effectively logging out the user.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester, with predefined course lists.
